step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Payment returned — name incorrect — cancel and reissue.”

Details: Type “Payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY] was returned in error by the client. The payment will be cancelled and reissued. Request submitted to IPOC.”
Select Save .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the returned payment issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 8.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the claim is in MPS.
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS, select 43 - Cancelled payment .
Remarks line 1: Type “Cancel returned payment and reissue to correct name.”

Remarks line 2: Type “T071-2 [for current year] or T071-8 [for previous year]-reason F-incorrect name-reissue payment-w/c [XXXX]-CT [XX]-gross amount [XXXX]-federal tax XX-provincial tax (if necessary) [XX]-net amount [XXXX]-PRN [XXXXXXXXXXXX].”

Remarks line 3 : If any information changed since the original claimant’s report was completed, type “Amend w/c [XXXX]. Client declares [claimant’s report details].” If any disentitlements apply, type “Impose D[XX] for w/c [XXXX]. [claimant’s report details].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the F-00-00-00 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Opening Sentence for Initial or Renewal or Continuing claim (2466) .

Text - Free Text (1612): Type “On [insert date], a request was submitted to reissue payment for payment [reference number] issued on [DD-MM-YYYY] for the weeks of [DD-MM-YYYY] to [DD-MM-YYYY]. Please be advised that the replacement time is 5 business days for direct deposit and 7 to 13 business days for regular mail.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the returned payment issue.
